views.caveat: Each patient's 10 parts (clinical attributes), divided by their sum so every bar is a whole; cases ordered by CD8 T CXCL13, highest first. Each cohort is compared with the view's other cohorts pooled, part by part: log2 of the ratio of means (each + 0.001), Welch's t from the cohorts' n, mean and variance, Benjamini–Hochberg across the 30 comparisons. Parts of a whole are not independent — one part's rise is the others' fall — and a case in two cohorts counts in both. Entropy is Shannon's (natural log) over each case's shares.

steps.title: Sum each part over the cohort's patients
steps.detail: The composition:moments query above: each patient's 10 parts read and put in part order inside the database; a patient with every part, none below zero and a sum above zero is kept, its parts divided by their sum; then over those patients n, Σp and Σp² per part, and Σ and Σ² of each one's Shannon entropy. No case's values leave the database in this query.

steps.title: Each cohort against the others pooled, per part; then Benjamini–Hochberg
steps.detail: The other cohorts' sums are added into one group. Effect: log2((mean + 0.001) / (others' mean + 0.001)). Test: Welch's unequal-variance t from each side's n, mean and variance (Σp² − (Σp)²/n)/(n − 1), two-sided; not tested when either side has under 2 patients or neither has any spread. q across every comparison tested.

method.verification: Welch's t from moments matches scipy 1.18.1 ttest_ind(equal_var=False) and Benjamini–Hochberg statsmodels multipletests, to a relative 1e-6 (test/moments-golden.test.ts).
